from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AssetTotalValue(BaseModel):
    """单份财报中记录的资产总计数据点"""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="公司名称")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="财务报告发布/报告期末日期")
    data_as_of_date: str | None = Field(description="资产数据对应的具体日期")
    asset_total_amount: float | None = Field(description="资产总计金额数值")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="货币单位，例如'元'")
    fiscal_year: int | None = Field(description="财报所属财年，例如2017")
    fiscal_quarter: int | None = Field(description="财报所属季度，1-4，例如1表示第一季度")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    asset_total_values: list[AssetTotalValue]
